Priya K: Quick async — optkit delivery status + blockers. TL;DR: quant recs ready for review; batching/caching rollout needs infra gating and a regression smoke pass. Who can own infra gating this week?
Tom H: I can take infra gating. Need perf numbers & the ops checklist. Link to PR? https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/451
Devin R: PR 451 is updated — perf table in PR description (seq=512, batch=16). Pushed fix for KV cache warmup. commit abc1234
Marta S: QA: regression alert on reranking tests this morning — failing prompt id: rerank-0472. I can run smoke but need a shadow lane and a stable seed set.
Priya K: @Tom H can you confirm capacity for 10% shadow and a Friday smoke window? @Devin R add perf harness link and command to reproduce. @Marta S attach failing test details to RD-312.
Tom H: Confirmed capacity for 10% shadow. Can schedule Friday 10:00 PT. Ops checklist: 1) Canary KV caching off -> on, 2) monitor token latency, 3) rollback plan.
Devin R: Perf harness: https://ci.redwood/inference/perf-harness
Run: ./scripts/run_perf.sh --model redwood-v2 --seq 512 --batch 16 --cache-warm
Also I left a small improvement to batching heuristic in PR.
Marta S: Good. I'll prepare the seed set and rerun the reranking suite after Dev gives green. Will post results to RD-312 and ping here.
infra-bot: capacity-monitor: GPU pool available: 24/32 GPUs free in us-west-2. Predicted headroom for 10% shadow: OK
Priya K: Action items: (A) @Tom H owns infra gating + Friday smoke; (B) @Devin R finalize PR + add harness link (done); (C) @Marta S run regression + report; (D) I'll update RD-312 with target canary Mon. If any blocker, flag here by EOD.
Tom H: Taking ownership. Will mark gating ticket INF-789 and post pre-checks.
Devin R: small follow-up: added a short note about sequence-length tail in PR description — may affect batch sizing. cc @Tom H
Marta S: Noted. I'll include tail cases in smoke. Thanks.
Priya K: Thanks team :thumbsup:
